stem:
Rekha walks along a straight path. Her friend records how far she goes in successive time intervals.

Which case is uniform linear motion?

options.text: Equal distances in equal time intervals.
Equal distances in unequal time intervals.
Unequal distances in equal time intervals.
Any motion along a straight path.

teacher.key_rationale: Uniform linear motion means equal distances in equal time intervals along a straight line. Equal distances with unequal times drop the equal-time condition; unequal distances in equal times is non-uniform; a straight path alone is not enough.
